summary: This pass expands the universe around labor-intensive grid execution and asset-integrity services. The reference lane is Quanta Services, which validates the demand and backlog signal for electric grid services. The underfollowed lane emphasizes smaller or less thematically crowded US-listed companies with transmission/distribution construction, utility maintenance, power delivery, testing, inspection, certification, geospatial, and commissioning exposure. Key chokepoint logic: grid capex does not become energized infrastructure without specialized crews, substation/transmission execution, outage coordination, inspection, and commissioning. Evidence is strongest for PWR, MYRG, PRIM, and TIC as direct or adjacent node participants; margin durability, backlog conversion, safety performance, labor availability, and utility customer concentration remain the next evidence gates.
